title: Encoded Lovász Sample Matrix
statement: Let $K,u,w,NK,r$ be finite bit strings. Suppose $w$ has length $|u|^2$, $NK$ has length $|u||K|$, $r$ has length $|u||NK|$, and either $K$ is nonempty or $u$ is empty. Then applying the encoded row procedure to $K$, the chunked adjacency word from $u,w$, and the chunked sample word from $NK,r$ yields the encoding of the matrix with $|u|$ rows and columns whose $(i,j)$ entry is the binary value of the length-$|K|$ block of $r$ beginning at position $(|u|i+j)|K|$ if the bit of $w$ at position $|u|i+j$ is true, and is zero otherwise.
